field_changes.old:
MyNetDiary is the calorie tracker and food diary you'll actually stick with: fast, accurate, and ad-free. Log your food in seconds with the free barcode scanner, Meal Scan, or quick search. Then get on with your day.

Proven Weight Loss Results
• Active members who tracked consistently lost an average of 1.4 lbs per week (MyNetDiary Efficacy Report).
• Over 32 million users have chosen MyNetDiary for calorie tracking, weight loss and healthy eating - many switched from other diet and nutrition apps.

Recognized Excellence
Ranked #1 in Forbes Health's Best Weight Loss Apps of 2025. Scored highest of 30 apps for behavioral strategies in the American Journal of Preventive Medicine. The New York Times: simpler, quicker, and better-looking than the competition. Featured in Today's Dietitian.

Why People Switch
Accuracy: MyNetDiary runs on a staff-verified food database of over 2 million foods with up to 108 nutrients from USDA and NCC research-grade sources, for accurate calorie, macro and micronutrient tracking. Most apps rely on crowdsourced data. We review 2,500-3,500 foods daily.

Speed: In our January 2026 test, we logged 127 foods in every major app. MyNetDiary took 31% fewer taps than the most popular calorie tracker.

Free Calorie Counter - weight loss made simple
• Food diary with favorites and copy-from-day.
• Free barcode scanner with accurate nutrition data from the verified food database.
• Food Label scanner: snap any food label to log its nutrients.
• Full macro and protein tracking.
• Deep, accurate nutrition tracking for free, with no ads and no account: up to 108 nutrients (vitamins, minerals, omegas, amino acids).
• Exercise tracker and water log.
• Calorie calculator, deficit tracking, and customizable weight loss dashboard.
• Daily diet coaching tips, meal reminders, shopping lists.
• Professional Connect: share your food diary with your dietitian, coach, or doctor. Used by dietitians and health professionals at no cost.
• Community success stories.
• Nutrition articles by Registered Dietitians.
• Wear OS watch app with tiles and complications: log foods by voice, track water and weight, daily summary, macro breakdown.
• Health Connect and Samsung Health sync: exercise, steps, and weight.

MyNetDiary Premium - unlock the full power of your diet and nutrition app
• Meal Scan: snap your plate and log it, matched against the staff-verified database.
• Fitness Tracker Sync: Fitbit, Garmin, and Withings for exercise calories and steps.
• GLP-1 Companion: nutrition-first support for Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, Zepbound, and other semaglutide or tirzepatide medications, with protein targets and muscle protection while you lose weight.
• Macro tracking and planning, calorie and macro cycling.
• Autologging: your regular meals (foods, amounts, days) logged automatically.
• Intermittent fasting.
• Diet Autopilot: your calorie budget adjusts as you lose weight.
• Advanced Autopilot adapts to your metabolism.
• Health tracking: measurements, blood pressure, blood glucose, A1C, ketones, medications.
• Trend Analysis with multi-variable charting: chart any tracked variables together, spot patterns, see the big picture of your diet and weight. Custom timelines, notes, and tags.
• Meal Planner.
• Recipe import.
• 600+ recipes and diet plans by Registered Dietitians: High-Protein, Low-Carb, Keto, and more.

Premium Plus is your AI-powered weight loss journey
• MyNetDiary AI Diet Coach: built on 20 years of weight loss expertise, with daily guidance based on what you actually ate, and trend charts suggested in conversation.
• AI Suggest Meals: meal suggestions tailored to your diet, calorie budget, and food preferences.
• AI Restaurant Menu Scan: best options for your diet when eating out.
• AI Voice Food Logging: speak your meals to log food.

Results may vary. MyNetDiary does not provide medical advice. All product names, logos, and brands are the property of their respective owners.
